summary: ACM Research, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 2,884,615 shares of Class A common stock at $52.00 per share to institutional and accredited investors. The offering price represents a 19.6% discount to the last sale price of $64.67 on May 11, 2026. The company is the issuer and seller; the filing is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration (No. 333-278041). Expected closing is on or about May 15, 2026. This is a standard marketed equity offering, not a special situation.
